entities.summary: Georges Politzer was a Hungarian-born French philosopher and Marxist theoretician of Hungarian Jewish origin, affectionately referred to by some as the "red-headed philosopher". He was a native of Oradea, a city in present-day Romania. He was murdered in Fort Mont-Valérien in Suresnes in the Holocaust.
